field_meanings.rule: Catala source: the readable specification. Validated by differential testing. It is NOT a proof and must never be labelled as proved.
field_meanings.proofs: Lean theorems: machine-checked statements about the Lean implementation. Only these may be labelled proved, and only for what `covers` says.
field_meanings.tests: Differential tests (difftest/mappings): evidence that Catala and Lean agree with Direct File on scenarios. Not a proof.
field_meanings.citations: Law behind the rule. origin "catala": found in the Catala headings or comments (see found_in). origin "curated": added by hand in scripts/gen_provenance.mjs for human review.

theorems.name: tentativeTax_nonneg_monotone
theorems.statement: theorem tentativeTax_nonneg_monotone (fs : FilingStatus) : NonnegMonotone (fun ti => tentativeTaxFor ti fs)
theorems.covers: Line 16 as a function of taxable income is nonnegative and monotone, for each filing status.

theorems.name: line16_matches_tax_table
theorems.statement: theorem line16_matches_tax_table (i : Form1040In) : MatchesTaxTable i.filingStatus (form1040 i).taxableIncome (form1040 i).tentativeTaxFromTaxableIncome
theorems.covers: On every return, line 16 equals the printed 2024 Tax Table amount of the row containing line 15. Covers taxable income below $100,000 only; vacuous above.

theorems.name: tentativeTax_matches_tax_table
theorems.statement: theorem tentativeTax_matches_tax_table (fs : FilingStatus) (ti : Int) : MatchesTaxTable fs ti (tentativeTaxFor ti fs)
theorems.covers: The line 16 function equals the printed Tax Table amount for every filing status and income in a table row.

theorems.name: tentativeTaxFor_eq_taxSpec
theorems.statement: theorem tentativeTaxFor_eq_taxSpec (fs : FilingStatus) {ti : Int} (h : ti ≤ noUpperBound) : tentativeTaxFor ti fs = taxSpec fs ti
theorems.covers: The line 16 function equals the rate-schedule specification `taxSpec` up to the $1-trillion sentinel. Not in the comparator set.

theorems.name: rows_cover
theorems.statement: theorem rows_cover (ti : Int) (h0 : 0 ≤ ti) (h1 : ti < dollars 100_000) : ∃ r ∈ rows, InRow r ti
theorems.covers: Every cent of taxable income in [$0, $100,000) lies in some Tax Table row, so the table theorem is not vacuous there.
